about.ADV1010:
The Advisor reads the register, the organisation, the plan, the qualifications, the accounts and the backups, and lists what looks wrong, from the most serious to simple tips. Each point says why it matters and what to do; open it to see the records concerned.

It shows only what you may already read, and it changes nothing: you decide and correct in the usual screens.
about.ATT2010: Upload the attendance workbook of the day. The calculation engine is locked: it gives exactly the numbers the previous application gave. A file already uploaded is refused, and a bad file never replaces the last good result.
about.EMP1010:
The employee register is the one source of truth for people in the whole ecosystem: manufacturing and accounting read it, they never change it.

Filter any column from its header, group the rows by a column from the column menu, or pick a preset above the grid. Double-click a row to edit it. A deleted employee goes to the Recycle Bin and can be restored; the history of every change is kept.
about.ORG1010: The organisation tree. Pick a unit to see its people, positions and sub-units; add a unit below the one selected. A unit is never really deleted: it goes to the Recycle Bin with its history.
about.ORG1020: A job is what a person does (Welder, HR officer). A position is one seat of a job in one department. Mark the critical jobs: the Advisor and the plan can then warn when they are uncovered.
about.ORG1030: One position holds one person. A vacant position is shown in the Advisor as a tip; two people in one position is an error to correct.
about.SEC9010: Each person has one user and one profile. A new user must change the first password at the first sign-in. The Advisor warns when a user holds two rights that should be separated.
about.SEC9020:
Tick the actions a profile may do, or start from a template, then save. The rights are checked by the server on every request, not only hidden on the screens.

Some pairs of rights should not sit with one person (for example managing users and changing employee records): the screen warns about them. The administrator profile always holds every right.
about.SEC9030: Every sign-in, refusal and change is written here and can never be edited or deleted. The line at the top says whether the chain is intact.
about.SHF1010: A night shift that ends after midnight counts as one work day: the day it starts. The times of a shift people already worked cannot change; create a new shift instead.
about.SHF1020: A calendar says which week days are rest days and which dates are holidays. The week starts on Saturday, as in Egypt.
about.SHF2010: A regular assignment never overlaps another regular one; a temporary one covers it for a period. An assignment that already started can only be ended, not changed.
about.SHF3010: The planned week, computed from the assignments, the calendars and the day changes. Click a day to change it (with a reason) or swap two people. The past is history: a day before today cannot be re-planned.
about.SHF3020: Choose a period and press Inquiry. Every planned day gets a verdict: as planned, absent, no record, on leave, worked a day off. Filter or group by the verdict column to find the problems quickly.
about.SKL1010: Define a skill once; give it a validity in months if certificates must be renewed.
about.SKL2010: Use the presets above the grid to see what expires soon or has expired. The expiry follows the validity of the skill unless you set a date.
about.SKL3010: One row per person, one column per skill. Click a cell to certify or re-certify. Expired qualifications are red; manufacturing refuses an unqualified person at a station that requires the skill.
about.SYS9060: Server settings apply to everyone. Your own preferences (theme, look, density, language) stay in this browser.
about.SYS9070: A backup is made automatically at the interval set in Settings, and each one is restored in a safe place to prove it works. A restore never overwrites data: it writes a new, compensating change.
about.SYS9100: The journal, the audit, the last backup, the recovery installer and the signing library, each with a clear verdict.

adv.disclaimer: The Advisor reads; it never changes a record. It sees only what your rights allow.
adv.empty_units.body: A unit without positions cannot hold anyone.
adv.empty_units.fix: Add its positions, or remove the unit if it is not used.
adv.empty_units.title: {n} departments or sections have no positions
adv.ending_soon.body: After the end date these people have no plan unless another assignment follows.
adv.ending_soon.fix: Check that a following assignment exists.
adv.ending_soon.title: {n} assignments end within {days} days
adv.left_not_closed.body: Their termination date has passed while their status is not Terminated: they still count as staff and may still be planned.
adv.left_not_closed.fix: Set their status to Terminated, or remove the date if they stay.
adv.left_not_closed.title: {n} people left but are still in service
adv.manager_gone.body: Their manager is terminated or no longer in the register.
adv.manager_gone.title: {n} people report to someone who left
adv.must_change.body: They will be asked to change it at the next sign-in.
adv.must_change.fix: Remind them to sign in once.
adv.must_change.title: {n} users still have their first password
adv.no_backup.body: A failed disk would lose every record.
adv.no_backup.title: There is no backup yet
adv.no_hire_date.body: The hire date drives seniority, leave rights and, later, payroll.
adv.no_hire_date.fix: Enter the hire date from the employment contract.
adv.no_hire_date.title: {n} employees have no hire date
adv.not_planned.body: They appear as unscheduled every day, and manufacturing cannot count them.
adv.not_planned.fix: Give each one a regular assignment (shift + calendar).
adv.not_planned.title: {n} active employees have no regular shift
adv.one_admin.body: If this person is away or forgets the password, nobody can manage users or restore a backup.
adv.one_admin.fix: Give a second trusted person the administrator profile.
adv.one_admin.title: Only one administrator
adv.position_shared.basis: Rule: one person per position (HR design, organisation).
adv.position_shared.body: A position is one seat: two people in it hide a missing position and make the head count and the reports to line wrong.
adv.position_shared.fix: Create the missing position and move one of the people to it.
adv.position_shared.title: {n} people share a position
adv.qual_expired.basis: Rule: a station with a requirement accepts only a valid qualification at the level.
adv.qual_expired.body: Manufacturing refuses these people at the stations that require the skill.
adv.qual_expired.fix: Re-certify them, or withdraw the qualification.
adv.qual_expired.title: {n} qualifications have expired
adv.qual_expiring.body: Plan the training or the test now, before the station refuses the person.
adv.qual_expiring.title: {n} qualifications expire within {days} days
adv.recovery_damaged.body: It no longer matches its fingerprint and cannot be trusted for a reinstall.
adv.recovery_damaged.fix: Install the same version again to replace it.
adv.recovery_damaged.title: The recovery installer is damaged
adv.recovery_missing.body: After a failed update you would need the installer of this version from elsewhere.
adv.recovery_missing.fix: Keep the installer of this version on the server (it is kept automatically after an install).
adv.recovery_missing.title: No recovery installer is kept
adv.sod.body: One person can both grant rights and change records, or delete records and restore backups over them: nobody would see the change.
adv.sod.fix: Split the rights between two profiles, or accept it knowingly for a very small team.
adv.sod.title: {n} users hold rights that should be separated
adv.terminated_no_date.body: Without the date, the history cannot say until when they worked.
adv.terminated_no_date.title: {n} terminated employees have no termination date
adv.terminated_planned.body: Their shift assignment is still running: the floor expects them.
adv.terminated_planned.fix: End the assignment on their last working day.
adv.terminated_planned.title: {n} people who left are still on the plan
adv.unplaced.body: Without a position a person has no department, no job and no manager in the structure; manufacturing and accounting cannot place them.
adv.unplaced.fix: Edit each employee and choose their position.
adv.unplaced.title: {n} employees have no position
adv.vacant_positions.body: Vacant seats may be planned hires, or positions nobody needs any more.
adv.vacant_positions.fix: Fill them, or move the ones no longer needed to the Recycle Bin.
adv.vacant_positions.title: {n} positions are vacant
